briefs.brief: Build a 24-hour prototype for neighborhood volunteers coordinating safe water collection after a flood. The demo must work offline with invented data and a screen reader. Do not collect names or phone numbers.

Help smallholder farmers decide how to share a scarce irrigation pump during a two-day hackathon. Assume no sensor feed, no reliable mobile data, and a low-cost shared device. Show a fair allocation demo.

Design a one-day build that helps teachers spot which arithmetic misconception to address next. Use only synthetic class examples, support screen readers, and avoid a generic chat tutor. Demonstrate a specific feedback loop.

A clinic wants a 30-hour prototype for missed follow-up handoffs. Do not diagnose, use only fictitious records, and keep personal health details off third-party APIs. The demo must show safe escalation and uncertainty.

Build a two-day prototype that helps informal merchants resolve disputed payments. No live bank integration, no real transaction data, and an auditable explanation are mandatory. Judges value demonstrability over a dashboard.

Build a 36-hour prototype for open-source teams checking eligibility for a fictional Web3 grant. Use a local fixture instead of scraping live grant pages. Require a reproducible rules trace, no wallet connection, and a concrete demo.
